Adaptive allocation is established prior work: FrugalGPT learns model cascades to trade inference cost against answer accuracy \citep{chen2023frugalgpt}, while Conformal Thinking calibrates reasoning stopping rules to specified error risks \citep{wang2026conformalthinking}. Decision-focused learning trains predictors for downstream optimization quality rather than prediction accuracy alone \citep{wilder2019melding}. Our prospective policy instead prioritizes extraction chunks using a bound on action-utility ambiguity and stops on conditional construction regret. It is neither a learned cascade nor a calibrated risk-control procedure; this operational distinction does not establish novelty priority or empirical superiority.

\textbf{Executable admission boundary.} The CPU reference profile checks exact record identity, source offsets, currency and a restricted, explicitly typed construction-price field before admitting a point interval; it rejects ambiguous or unsupported prose. Repairs must pass the same checks and produce nested, nonempty intervals. Appendix~\ref{app:admission} specifies the contract and failure handling. This profile makes admission reproducible, but cannot certify unrestricted language or the source's factual accuracy. Since the parser can itself read every field it admits, parser-only calculation remains a necessary comparator.

after: Intervals crossing no feasible bid contribute zero. For any fixed bid, the chunk contribution to $H_t-L_t$ is at most $W_t(g)$ because the sum of per-record maxima bounds the maximum of the corresponding sum. Thus $W_t$ bounds potential utility uncertainty, not expected repair gain.
